explanation: In C++, function templates allow the definition of generic functions that can operate on different data types without rewriting code for each type. When combined with operator overloading, templates enable the creation of flexible, type-independent operators that work seamlessly with user-defined types and standard library containers. This approach promotes code reusability, type safety, and consistency across various data types, especially in the context of the Standard Template Library (STL).
